verdict: Maybe. London Bubble pitched waffle chips on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. A new format stands out on shelves, but snacks are a crowded market, and buyers must want to repurchase after the novelty wears off.
angle: Waffle-cut chips have a different texture and hold flavour well. A distinctive format can help you get attention in quick commerce and supermarkets. Taste tests and flavour variety drive repeat purchases.
